book_meta.author: Oxford Dominoes Level 1 graded reader (football story, Brazil)

character_voice_map.sample_quote: I'm only sixteen, but I live football. In the day, I play football; at night, I sleep football. I eat and drink football! The beautiful game!
Bad! Very bad! We must win this game! Do you want to win the Cup or not?
Junior looks at me and gives a big smile.
He's thinking, 'Who is this boy? How good is he? Can he help us win?'
Here, Tino, take this for luck. You're little now, but one day you're going to be a big star, an amazing player.
It's the last game of the year. We need to win to get the Cup.

emotion_snapshot.notes: 球队落后两球，更衣室气氛压抑，教练愤怒斥责，主角即将首次登场的紧张与期待交织

book.story_line_summary: 十六岁的巴西少年Tino（Albertino）加入Stars足球队，在赛季决赛中球队上半场0-2落后于Stripes队。愤怒的教练Zangado在中场休息时做出人员调整，让替补席上的Tino首发出场与队长Lenda搭档锋线。Tino怀揣母亲给的幸运小星星，带着对足球的纯粹热爱和初登大舞台的紧张兴奋走上球场。故事聚焦于这场逆境中的关键下半场，展现年轻球员的成长、团队的凝聚力以及巴西足球的激情与信念。
book.global_style_notes: 第一人称青少年视角叙事，语言简洁明快，符合分级读物Level 1特点。对话占比大，需体现巴西葡萄牙语语境下的英语口语特色。教练Zangado台词需表现权威与愤怒；Tino内心独白需传达纯真热血；Lenda台词需体现老将的冷静与审视。环境音效建议包含球场观众呐喊、哨声、脚步声等。

The text uses repetitive, rhythmic phrasing ('I play football; at night, I sleep football') to convey obsession and joy. For graded readers (Level A), baseline speed is kept slow (0.75-0.9). No voice_id changes needed (single speaker).
